steps.title: Configure App Meta and Package Namespace
steps.description: Align the system metadata with 'Real3DCarAdventure' package identity.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest Configurations
steps.description: Specify screen orientation and GL hardware surface acceleration configs.

steps.title: Configure Android Gradle Script
steps.description: Set up strict compilation targets, Java 8 standard levels, and clean configuration parameters.

steps.title: Add Day Mode and Night Mode Toggle into UI Dashboard
steps.description: Incorporate a customizable, highly stylized Mode Switch button into the top left header dashboard layout.

steps.title: Implement Finger Swipe Gesture Steering Controls
steps.description: Implement a custom TouchListener tracking delta-X drag coordinates to smoothly steer the sports vehicle across highway lanes.

steps.title: Integrate Day and Night Ambient Lighting State machine
steps.description: Program scenic daylight and dark neon midnight transitions, changing sky clear colors, grass, guardrails, and street environments.

steps.title: Enhance Skyscraper Building Architecture Realism
steps.description: Refactor procedural rendering to build multi-tiered buildings with concrete bases, tall towers, spires, flashing top hazard beacons, and elegant window grids.

steps.title: Implement Volumetric Realistic Headlights with Fade Effect
steps.description: Construct multi-layered alpha-blended light cones on the vehicle front that realistically widen, diffuse, and fade out into the dark night sky.

steps.title: Smooth Out Speed Physics and Interpolate Steering Movement
steps.description: Incorporate target-coordinate lerping, camera tracking follow inertia, and dynamic vehicle chassis suspension roll-tilt animations.

steps.title: Building Real3DCarAdventure
steps.description: Initiate compiler and verify GL ES context bindings and responsive controls.
